prompt.text:
Repair the buggy source below without changing the required API.

File contract: Write CommonJS module solution.js and export the named function.
Required API: exports.compactOrderedEvents = function(seq, keys, values) returning number[] | null
Behavior: The three arrays encode events with strictly increasing sequence numbers. Reject unequal lengths, non-increasing sequence numbers, or empty keys. Keep only the final event for each key and return its value, ordered by the final events' positions; empty input succeeds.
Visible example: seq [1,2,3,8], keys [a,b,a,c], values [4,7,9,2] return [7,9,2].

Buggy source to repair:

exports.compactOrderedEvents=(seq,keys,values)=>{if(seq.length!==keys.length||seq.length!==values.length)return null;const seen=new Set;return values.filter((_,i)=>seen.has(keys[i])?false:(seen.add(keys[i]),true))}

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
